title: Automatic Renewal of Northgate Memberships
content:
**1. Who may use it.** Automatic renewal of a Northgate Memberships membership may be switched on only for a tier that allows automatic renewal, and only on a payment method listed among the tier's accepted automatic renewal payment methods.

**2. Status.** Automatic renewal is changed only on a membership whose status is active; an expired membership must be renewed first.

**3. Northgate Rewards Visa.** Automatic renewal on the Northgate Rewards Visa payment method is set up only when the member holds a Northgate Rewards Visa card account (Northgate Credit Cards) in active status linked to this membership. The card account's status and its linked membership are read from the card account record.

| Card account linked to this membership | Status | Automatic renewal on the Northgate Rewards Visa |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa account | active | may be set up |
| Northgate Rewards Visa account | any other status | not set up |
| none linked | — | not set up |

**4. Timing.** The reminder email goes out the tier's reminder period (in days) before the expiry date; the renewal fee is charged the tier's charge offset (in days) after the expiry date, as an on-time renewal under the renewal dating rules.

**5. Declined charges.** A declined charge is retried the tier's number of retries, the tier's retry interval apart; if every retry is declined the membership lapses to expired and automatic renewal stays on until the member changes it.

**6. Switching off.** The member may switch automatic renewal off at any time before the charge posts; switching it off after the renewal fee has posted does not reverse that fee, which can only be recovered through a cancellation under the cancellation terms.

## Hypothetical cases

- A Club Plus member asks to put automatic renewal on a debit card: allowed if debit card is among the tier's accepted methods (it is on the consumer tiers that allow automatic renewal).
- A member switches automatic renewal off the day after the renewal fee posted: the fee stands; it is recoverable only through a cancellation.
- A Student Club member asks for automatic renewal: the tier does not allow it.
